verdict.rationale: Ops users can inspect executions through the Web UI and the CLI, which is documented for managing, monitoring and debugging workflows. Closed workflow histories can be archived for longer retention, and users confirm a per-workflow event log exists. A community user reports that after deploying new code you can reset a workflow's execution state to before a given statement and it re-runs from there, which is resume-from-failing-step; others confirm manual retry. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the reset/re-run-from-step feature, first-party docs for event-history inspection, and good error visibility, since one user says errors are often buried in the event log.
